lessons: A diff fingerprint is not authorship evidence. tests/test_determinism_85.py matched SOURCE_UNSUPPORTED_GRAMMAR because the other agent added that string at 20:58. Check the mtime window and whether the implementation the assertions need is inside the same commit.
green-in-working-tree proves nothing about the commit. Commit claims get verified by cloning HEAD and running there.
committing a shared file (server.py) makes its untracked imports load-bearing. Before committing it, import it from a clean checkout.
never rebase/rewrite while other agents are committing into the same repo; repair forward instead. 68c60ca -> 2bfe774 -> 378dc79 landed from another agent mid-task.
